title: Nonce replay relies on ensureGuard marking FactorySandbox ready first
description:
FactorySandbox.listProcesses returns nothing while the in-memory ready flag is false, as it is after a deploy restarts the DO. Tracked bash's resume then misses the live process and starts the command again. Today ensureGuard's door.run sets ready first; with guardDir null (a supported option) the tool would run twice. The resume tests use guardDir null with fakes that do not model ready.
evidence: cloudflare/src/factory-sandbox.ts:597; harness/src/env/factory-sandbox.ts:758,774-786; harness/test/tracked-bash-resume.test.ts
